newsitem.title: USA: KEDO buys fuel oil from LG-Caltex, Petro Diamond.
newsitem.headline: KEDO buys fuel oil from LG-Caltex, Petro Diamond.

text.p: The Korean Peninsula Energy Development Organization (KEDO) Monday bought 21,000 tonnes of residual fuel from LG-Caltex Oil Corp and 20,000 tonnes from Petro Diamond Co Ltd, KEDO's broker International Services Corp said.

LG-Caltex was awarded a contract to supply 21,000 tonnes plus or minus 10 percent FOB Yocheon, South Korea, April 20-24, at $108.75 per tonne, with a freight contract of $16.00 per tonne for delivery to Nampo and Songrim, North Korea.

Petro Diamond was awarded a contract to supply 20,000 tonnes plus or minus 10 percent FOB Okinawa, Japan, April 20-24, at $107.50 per tonne, with a freight contract of $15.50 per tonne for delivery to Sonbong, North Korea.
The import tender, which closed on March 26, was for about 42,000 tonnes of maximum two percent sulfur residual fuel for delivery to North Korea in April.
KEDO, an organization set up to carry out an international accord designed to freeze North Korea's nuclear weapons program, has agreed to supply the country with 500,000 tonnes of fuel oil annually.
Petro Diamond is a unit of Mitsubishi Corp.
